role.name: Bai Kong Shao
role.back: My father is an aircraft mechanic named Bai Jiujian, working at MG Airlines. When I was a child, due to work reasons, he often brought back some airplane models and drawings and told me about the structure of airplanes. A boy of that age, who wouldn't want to fly a plane and stand shoulder to shoulder with the sun! So, from a young age, I aspired to become a pilot. Dad said that airplanes are delicate things, and whether it's maintenance or piloting, they need to be meticulous. He encouraged me to cultivate a focused and serious attitude. I particularly admire him because he himself is such a person who has never made any mistakes in his many years of work.
